messages:
sanjay: FYI after the Orion-13B 4-bit qlora rollout we started seeing embedding drift and some unexpected rerank order flips on a few prod queries. latency up ~12ms for rerank path :thinking:
anna: ugh. is this only on quantized variant or across the board?
sanjay: looks isolated to the 4bit variant. non-quant baseline matches expected embeddings. quick repro pasted below.
sanjay: ```
input: "What's the nearest EV charger in SF?"
baseline embedding cosine to stored poi vector: 0.87
4bit qlora embedding cosine: 0.63
```
anna: can you share the inference config (batching/kv cache flags)?
sanjay: using default serve config for orion-13b-q4_v2, continuous batching on, kv_cache=true, fusedquant=true.
lucy: I rolled a short canary fallback to q8 for dedicated pool — rerank latency returned to normal and embedding cosines aligned with baseline. So performance impact + quality both appear tied to q4 path.
mike: looking at runtime logs, saw kernel selection degrade to int4_fallback at some sequence lengths. suspicious: matmul kernel swapped at step 32 for longer contexts. snippet: ```kernel_select: fusedattn_xla -> int4_fallback_matmul @ seq=512```
eva: could be quant scale calibration mismatch or per-channel vs per-tensor issue. did we run the per-channel remap step after tokenizer changes?
sanjay: tokenizer unchanged. we did rerun post-qlora calibrate step but I need to double-check param order. opening a ticket: https://redwood.internal/issue/ML-2039 (will add eval artifacts). :spiral_note_pad:
anna: quick checks: 1) run 1k-sample cosine eval (baseline vs q4) 2) flush and rewarm kv cache 3) rerun quant with per-channel scales and export weights with explicit dtype tags
lucy: also add a short smoke harness to assert embedding stability (cosine >= 0.8) for top-k retrievals before rollout. if fails, block auto-rollout.
mike: infra action: pin kernel selection to stable fused matmul for the canary pool while ML triages. I'll deploy a kernel lock for 2 hours. :gear:
ci-bot: Canary rollout completed for orion-13b-q4_v2 -> 2/3 nodes. Monitoring enabled.
sanjay: thanks. I'll run the calibration re-export and post the diff of embedding vectors. will flag if we need QAT.
eva: if calibration doesn't fix it, try per-channel quant + small-scale retraining (1 epoch) against embedding objective. QAT usually fixes these drift cases.
anna: good plan. capture eval, logs, kernel selection traces, and we'll aim for a hotfix tomorrow morning if needed. :eyes:
sanjay: noted — creating a short postmortem template in the ticket. updating channel with results in ~2 hours.
